name: connect-code-guard
description: Typos, codes in commands, and the private form's guidance for /connect (issue #104). A typo reports 'unknown subcommand', bare /connect shows how to get a code, a code typed into /connect approve is refused, and the code never reaches the log.

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-connect-codes"; mkdir -p "$H"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab"; printf "%s" "{\"kollabor\":{\"llm\":{\"active_profile\":\"openai-test\",\"profiles\":{\"openai-test\":{\"provider\":\"openai\",\"model\":\"gpt-5.5\",\"base_url\":\"https://api.openai.com/v1\",\"api_key\":\"sk-test-dummy\",\"supports_tools\":true}}}},\"plugins\":{\"hub\":{\"enabled\":true}}}" > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -s "$R/plugins" "$H/plugins"; cd "$H"; HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon'

steps.description: no DNS error for a typo

a code typed into a command is refused
